jokers.description: Every joker in Far Far West: rarity, slot cost, max copies, effect and the weapons it fits, extracted from the game files.
jokers.heading: Jokers
jokers.intro: The {count} jokers of the game, by rarity. The hero, the main weapon and the secondary weapon each have their own joker slots: 14 unlocked by levels, plus 2 bought at the prestige shop. A joker costs as many slots as the dots on its card.

joker.gambled: Can be won at the gamble machine
joker.unlockUnique: Reach the level {level} with the {weapon}, then buy it in the lobby.
joker.unlockMastery: Reach the level {level} in the {school} school.
joker.unlockChallenge: Unlocked by a challenge in game.
joker.missionOnly: This joker cannot be equipped in the lobby : it drops only in missions, does not count in joker slots and disappears when the mission ends.

weapons.title: Every weapon in Far Far West : main, secondary and utility
weapons.description: The {main} main weapons, {sidearms} secondary weapons and {utilities} utility of Far Far West, with their upgrades and jokers they can equip
weapons.heading: Weapons
weapons.intro: A build has a main weapon, a secondary weapon with  its element, and a utility. The hero and each weapon have their own level, upgrade points and joker slots.
